changes.schema: Journal version 3 adds task_plans, task_plan_packages, task_package_deps and task_workspace_locks; legacy v1/v2 journals migrate without changing existing task identities; funding accepts the shared version
changes.submission: One journal transaction creates the plan, all package task/attempt/operation/outbox rows and dependency edges. Owner request keys and canonical hashes deduplicate; invalid targets roll back every row
changes.readiness: Both ready and claim require every predecessor succeeded. Failure blocks undispatched descendants; independent branches continue. Parent success requires every package succeeded
changes.cancellation: Package cancellation propagates down its dependencies; plan cancellation covers every branch. Undispatched packages are skipped. Unknown stop preserves parent cancelling and requires original-operation reconciliation
changes.locks: Workspace-write claim atomically locks the Host machine/workspace pair; reads and independent workspaces continue. Cancelling and recovered unknown operations retain locks until trusted reconciliation
changes.authorization: Actual Agent metadata stamps the Session. Only committed Main private chat or owner actions can delegate to authorized directory Bots; targets are rechecked at dispatch. A finished target package cannot authorize cancellation of the planner-owned successors
changes.product: Three bounded plan tools, owner submit/cancel actions, durable plan projection and dependency/cancellation UI. Existing single-task and legacy MR paths retain their semantics
